replies.author: Ogrey
replies.body:
I'd rather teach you how to make a YML, not making one for you.
Why, you might ask.
We make the YML, but what if the map doesn't really fit Avicus standards?
The Map Devs (or me, atleast) will be only helping users to make YMLs by instructing them on how to make one (step by step, or just parts you do not understand).
